reference_sql:
WITH export_groups AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the sign_up events of 1 to 30 November 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS export_signups
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  GROUP BY traffic_source.source, traffic_source.medium
), november_signups AS (
  -- one row per signup whose signup_ts falls on a Dublin day of November 2025
  SELECT visitor_id
  FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
), first_starts AS (
  -- one row per visitor who signed up in November: the start of that visitor's first session
  SELECT s.visitor_id, MIN(s.session_start) AS first_start
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN november_signups n ON n.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  GROUP BY s.visitor_id
), backend_groups AS (
  -- one row per first-session source and medium: November's signups, a missing UTM value read as direct
  SELECT COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COUNT(*) AS backend_signups
  FROM first_starts f
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = f.visitor_id AND s.session_start = f.first_start
  GROUP BY COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)'), COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)')
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.source, b.source) AS source, COALESCE(e.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(e.export_signups, 0) AS export_signups, COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS backend_signups,
  COALESCE(e.export_signups, 0) - COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS difference
FROM export_groups e
FULL JOIN backend_groups b ON b.source = e.source AND b.medium = e.medium

WITH export_groups AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the sign_up events of 1 to 30 November 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS export_signups
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  GROUP BY traffic_source.source, traffic_source.medium
), backend_groups AS (
  -- one row per first-session source and medium: November's signups, each through the visitor's first session
  SELECT COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COUNT(*) AS backend_signups
  FROM signups g
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = g.visitor_id
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', g.signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions x WHERE x.visitor_id = s.visitor_id AND x.session_start < s.session_start)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)'), COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)')
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.source, b.source) AS source, COALESCE(e.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(e.export_signups, 0) AS export_signups, COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS backend_signups,
  COALESCE(e.export_signups, 0) - COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS difference
FROM export_groups e
FULL JOIN backend_groups b ON b.source = e.source AND b.medium = e.medium

solver.query:
WITH su AS (
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
), fs AS (
  SELECT visitor_id, utm_source, utm_medium
  FROM (
    SELECT s.visitor_id, s.utm_source, s.utm_medium,
      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start) AS rn
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE s.visitor_id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM su)
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
e AS (
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'sign_up' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), b AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(fs.utm_source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(fs.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM su LEFT JOIN fs ON fs.visitor_id = su.visitor_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.source, b.source) AS source, COALESCE(e.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS export_signups, COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS backend_signups,
  COALESCE(e.c, 0) - COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS difference
FROM e FULL JOIN b ON e.source = b.source AND e.medium = b.medium
